purpose: This table is the carrier reference dimension from the nycflights13 airlines source, mapping each two-letter BTS carrier code to its full legal name for the sixteen carriers that flew out of New York City in 2013; it is intended to feed flight fact tables that need to resolve or display a carrier's full name.
usage: Join downstream flight records to this table on carrier_code to attach carrier_name; both columns are fully populated (null_rate 0.0) and unique across the 16 rows, so no null-filtering or dedupe logic is required before joining.
limitations: Coverage is limited to the 16 carriers observed flying from NYC airports in 2013 per the nycflights13 source and is not a comprehensive or current BTS carrier list; the table carries no effective-date or versioning column, so carrier name changes over time are not represented, and the original Airbyte capture metadata (raw id, extraction timestamp, meta) was dropped as non-business data.
